name: serpapi_trends
notes: US Google-Trends interest for worry terms (weekly, 0-100). Keyed (SerpApi free tier). Solves the pytrends datacenter-IP 429.
caveats: Each term is fetched SEPARATELY -> each series is 0-100 within its OWN window (not cross-term normalized); the analysis z-scores per term and averages worry terms into an index. Values are relative search interest, not absolute volume; US/EN only.
